GOVERNOR'S OFFICE

OFFICE OF STATE PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT

COMMONWEALTH OF PENNSYLVANIA

HARRISBURG, PA. 17120
August 8, 1973
Mr. Robert Kaplan
U. S. Department of Housing and
Urban Development
Court House Annex
Spruce and Adams Streets
Scranton, Pennsylvania
Dear Mr. Kaplan:
The Department of Housing and Urban Development has transmitted to the Pennsylvania State Clearinghouse copies of Draft Environmental Impact Statements for various Disaster Urban Renewal projects in Pennsylvania.
Attached to this letter please find comments from the Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Resources on the following projects:
Penn Susquehanna U.R., Harrisburg Downtown U.R., Wilkes-Barre Kingston U.R. Lock Haven U.R. Milton and Turbot U.R.
Please consider these comments the official response of the Commonwealth for these draft environmental statements.
Sincerely,
Richard A. Heiss, Coordinator Pennsylvania State Clearinghouse
RAH:rew
